# Key Sailing Sarasota

> Private sailing charters on the Key Breeze, a 41' Morgan yacht, with U.S. Coast Guard Master Captain Tim and Jan (Hamel) Solomon at Marina Jack in Sarasota, Florida. Sarasota's #1 Sailing Charter, established 1996.

- Where: Marina Jack, 2 Marina Plaza, Slip E-19, Sarasota FL 34236
- Book: call, text or WhatsApp 941-346-7245 (SAIL) anytime, 24/7, or use the request form at https://siestakeysailing.com/email-us. No deposit.
- Price: $200 per hour for the whole yacht, a couple or up to six guests, covering everything but voluntary gratuity. More than 6 guests: extras welcome up to 12 in total for $80 apiece. Not a per person ticket, not a crowded party boat. The 3 hour experience is the most popular.
- Cruises: morning, afternoon and sunset cruises on Sarasota Bay and the Gulf of Mexico; optional sailing lessons; chocolates for everyone.
- Payment: Venmo, Zelle, credit cards, debit cards, checks or cash.
- Languages: English and Spanish.
- When Tim and Jan are away: Captain Jeremy Brubaker, (765) 414-6031. If you can't reach Jan, call Donna at (941) 284-9448.
